```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)

out_dir <- file.path(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path), "output")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


# ── STUDY 1: ASU ─────────────────────────────────────────────

robot_raw <- read.csv(
  "/path/to/local-user/ASU Dropbox/Katsiaryna Siamionava/Research_ASU/Robot co-creation/Experiment_survey/RobotSurvey_v102225.csv"
)
robot_raw$User.ID    <- trimws(robot_raw$User.ID)
robot_raw$Version.ID <- trimws(robot_raw$Version.ID)

# Fitbit HR data is stored in the interview/LIWC file (not in the survey CSV)
fitbit_asu <- read.csv(
  "/path/to/local-user/ASU Dropbox/Katsiaryna Siamionava/Research_ASU/Robot co-creation/Interview Analysis/data_interview_liwc_results.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = TRUE
)
fitbit_asu$User.ID <- trimws(as.character(fitbit_asu$User.ID))
fitbit_asu <- fitbit_asu %>%
  select(User.ID, Fitbit1 = FitbitMeasure1, Fitbit2 = FitbitMeasure2) %>%
  distinct(User.ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

robot_raw <- robot_raw %>%
  left_join(fitbit_asu, by = "User.ID")

cat("ASU participants with Fitbit data:",
    sum(!is.na(robot_raw$Fitbit1)), "of", nrow(robot_raw), "\n")

asu <- robot_raw %>%
  filter(as.character(X2.17) == "a") %>%          # completed drink order
  filter(!User.ID %in% c(114, 209, 76))            # a priori exclusions

cat("ASU rows after pre-screening:", nrow(asu), "\n")

# Experimental conditions
asu$wd_flag      <- ifelse(grepl("WD", asu$Version.ID), 1, 0)
asu$version_code <- str_extract(asu$Version.ID, "V\\d+")
asu$version_code <- relevel(as.factor(asu$version_code), ref = "V4")
asu <- asu %>%
  mutate(version_enc = case_when(
    version_code == "V1" ~ "create_av",
    version_code == "V2" ~ "human_av",
    version_code == "V3" ~ "animal_av",
    version_code == "V4" ~ "no_av",
    TRUE                 ~ NA_character_
  ))
asu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(asu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")

# Composites
asu$X2.16.3_r    <- 8 - asu$X2.16.3
asu$flawless     <- (asu$X2.16.1 + asu$X2.16.2 + asu$X2.16.3_r) / 3
asu$sat          <- (asu$X2.7.1  + asu$X2.7.2  + asu$X2.7.3)    / 3
asu$sat2         <- (asu$X2.8.1  + asu$X2.8.2  + asu$X2.8.3 +
                      asu$X2.8.4 + asu$X2.8.5)                   / 5
asu$serv_qual    <- (asu$X2.11.a + asu$X2.11.b + asu$X2.11.c)   / 3
asu$reuse        <- (asu$X2.12.1 + asu$X2.12.2 + asu$X2.12.3)   / 3
asu$unique_perc  <- (asu$X2.5.1  + asu$X2.5.2  + asu$X2.5.3)    / 3
asu$custom_perc  <- (asu$X2.2.1  + asu$X2.2.2  + asu$X2.2.3)    / 3
asu$close_perc   <- (asu$X2.13.1 + asu$X2.13.2 + asu$X2.13.3)   / 3
asu$like_perc    <- (asu$X2.6.1  + asu$X2.6.2  + asu$X2.6.3)    / 3
asu$control_perc <- (asu$X2.3.1  + asu$X2.3.2  + asu$X2.3.3)    / 3
asu$effort_perc  <- (asu$X2.4.1  + asu$X2.4.2  + asu$X2.4.3)    / 3
asu$design_attract <- (asu$X2.14.1 + asu$X2.14.2 + asu$X2.14.3) / 3

asu$tip     <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ifelse(asu$X2.1.1 == "25+", 25, asu$X2.1.1)))
asu$revisit <- ifelse(asu$X2.9 == "Yes", 1, 0)

# Fix data-entry error: "1,7" recorded instead of "1" in X1.2
asu$X1.2[asu$X1.2 == "1,7"] <- "1"
asu$X1.2 <- as.numeric(as.character(asu$X1.2))

asu$subj_stress1 <- (asu$X1.2 + (8 - asu$X1.1) + asu$X1.3 + asu$X1.4 +
                       asu$X1.5 + asu$X1.7 + (8 - asu$X1.6)) / 7

asu$racewhite <- as.numeric(ifelse(asu$X2.21 == "f", 1, 0))
asu$gender    <- as.numeric(ifelse(asu$X2.18 == "Male", 1, 0))

asu$X2.19 <- trimws(asu$X2.19)
asu <- asu %>%
  mutate(age = case_when(
    X2.19 == "a" ~ 1, X2.19 == "b" ~ 2, X2.19 == "c" ~ 3,
    X2.19 == "d" ~ 4, X2.19 == "e" ~ 5, X2.19 == "f" ~ 6,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
asu$educ <- trimws(asu$educ)
asu <- asu %>%
  mutate(educ = case_when(
    educ == "a" ~ 1, educ == "b" ~ 2, educ == "c" ~ 3,
    educ == "d" ~ 4, educ == "e" ~ 5, TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
asu$robot_familiar <- as.integer(asu$X2.22.a)
asu$robot_comfort  <- as.integer(asu$X2.22.b)

# Complete-case filter
cols_asu <- c(
  "X2.16.1","X2.16.2","X2.16.3","X2.7.1","X2.7.2","X2.7.3",
  "X2.11.a","X2.11.b","X2.11.c","X2.5.1","X2.5.2","X2.5.3",
  "X2.1.1","version_code","educ","age","racewhite","gender",
  "X2.9","X2.22.a","X2.22.b","subj_stress1"
)
cols_asu <- cols_asu[cols_asu %in% names(asu)]
asu <- asu[complete.cases(asu[, cols_asu]), ]
asu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(asu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")
cat("ASU N after complete-case filter:", nrow(asu), "\n")

# Cook's distance — flag influential observations
cutoff_asu <- 4 / nrow(asu)
cook_models_asu <- list(
  unique   = lm(X2.5.1  ~ as.factor(version_code) * wd_flag, data = asu),
  flawless = lm(flawless    ~ version_enc * wd_flag,             data = asu)
)
cook_list_asu <- lapply(cook_models_asu, cooks.distance)

top10_asu <- lapply(names(cook_list_asu), function(nm) {
  cd  <- cook_list_asu[[nm]]
  idx <- order(cd, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(10, length(cd))]
  data.frame(model = nm, User.ID = asu$User.ID[idx],
             cooks_d = round(cd[idx], 5), above_cutoff = cd[idx] > cutoff_asu)
}) %>% bind_rows()

influence_asu <- top10_asu %>%
  filter(above_cutoff) %>%
  group_by(User.ID) %>%
  summarise(n_models = n(), max_cooks_d = max(cooks_d), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_models), desc(max_cooks_d))

cat("\nASU influential participants (above 4/n threshold):\n")
print(influence_asu, row.names = FALSE)

rm_top3_asu <- influence_asu$User.ID[1:min(3, nrow(influence_asu))]
cat("ASU rm_top3_infl — removing:", rm_top3_asu, "\n")

d_asu <- asu %>% filter(!User.ID %in% rm_top3_asu)
d_asu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(d_asu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")
cat("ASU final N:", nrow(d_asu), "\n")
print(table(d_asu$version_enc, d_asu$wd_flag))

```

```{r}
osu <- osu_raw %>% clean_names()

osu <- osu %>% rename(

  X2.13.2 = x2_13_2_personal_ownership,
  X2.13.3 = x2_13_3_service_robot_incorporate_s_a_part_of_myself,
  X2.14.1 = x2_14_1_appealing_design,
  X2.14.2 = x2_14_2_obot_ordering_system_is_attractive,
  X2.14.3 = x2_14_3_design_of_the_service_robot_ordering_system_looks_great,

  X2.17   = x2_17_what_purchase_did_you_complete,
  X2.18   = x2_18_gender, X2.19 = x2_19_age,
  X2.20   = x2_20_level_of_education, X2.21 = x2_21_race,
  X2.22.a = x2_22a_are_your_familiar_with_service_robots,
  X2.22.b = x2_22b_do_you_feel_comfortable_using_service_robots,
  wd_flag = correct_0_incorrect_1_drinks
)

osu$User.ID    <- trimws(osu$User.ID)
osu$Version<- trimws(osu$Version)


osu <- osu %>%
  mutate(version_enc = case_when(
    Version == "v1r" ~ "create_av",
    Version == "v2r" ~ "human_av",
    Version == "v4r" ~ "no_av",
    TRUE                 ~ NA_character_
  ))
osu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(osu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")

# Numeric conversion (letter-coded vars excluded)
to_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
num_cols_osu <- c(
  "X1.1","X1.2","X1.3","X1.4","X1.5","X1.6","X1.7",
  "X2.1","X2.2","X2.3","X2.4","X2.5","X2.6","X2.7",
  "X2.2.1","X2.2.2","X2.2.3","X2.3.1","X2.3.2","X2.3.3",
  "X2.4.1","X2.4.2","X2.4.3","X2.5.1","X2.5.2","X2.5.3",
  "X2.6.1","X2.6.2","X2.6.3","X2.7.1","X2.7.2","X2.7.3",
  "X2.8.1","X2.8.2","X2.8.3","X2.8.4","X2.8.5",
  "X2.11.a","X2.11.b","X2.11.c",
  "X2.12.1","X2.12.2","X2.12.3","X2.13.1","X2.13.2","X2.13.3",
  "X2.14.1","X2.14.2","X2.14.3",
  "X2.15","X2.16.1","X2.16.2","X2.16.3","X2.22.a","X2.22.b",
  "Fitbit1","Fitbit2"
)
num_cols_osu <- num_cols_osu[num_cols_osu %in% names(osu)]
osu <- osu %>% mutate(across(all_of(num_cols_osu), to_num))

# Recode letter-coded items
osu$X2.9.1 <- case_when(
  trimws(as.character(osu$X2.9.1)) == "a" ~ 1,
  trimws(as.character(osu$X2.9.1)) == "b" ~ 0,
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
)
osu$X2.9.2 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(as.character(osu$X2.9.2))))
tip_pct_map  <- c(a=0, b=10, c=15, d=18, e=20, f=25, g=30)
disc_pct_map <- c(a=0, b=10, c=15, d=18, e=20, f=25)
osu$tip_robot    <- unname(tip_pct_map[trimws(as.character(osu$tip_robot))])
osu$tip_human    <- unname(tip_pct_map[trimws(as.character(osu$tip_human))])
osu$tip_discount <- unname(disc_pct_map[trimws(as.character(osu$tip_discount))])

# Composites
osu$X2.16.3_r  <- 8 - osu$X2.16.3
osu$flawless   <- (osu$X2.16.1 + osu$X2.16.2 + osu$X2.16.3_r) / 3
osu$sat        <- (osu$X2.7.1  + osu$X2.7.2  + osu$X2.7.3)    / 3
osu$sat2       <- (osu$X2.8.1  + osu$X2.8.2  + osu$X2.8.3 +
                    osu$X2.8.4 + osu$X2.8.5)                   / 5
osu$serv_qual  <- (osu$X2.11.a + osu$X2.11.b + osu$X2.11.c)   / 3
osu$reuse      <- (osu$X2.12.1 + osu$X2.12.2 + osu$X2.12.3)   / 3
osu$unique_perc  <- (osu$X2.5.1  + osu$X2.5.2  + osu$X2.5.3)  / 3
osu$custom_perc  <- (osu$X2.2.1  + osu$X2.2.2  + osu$X2.2.3)  / 3
osu$close_perc   <- (osu$X2.13.1 + osu$X2.13.2 + osu$X2.13.3) / 3
osu$like_perc    <- (osu$X2.6.1  + osu$X2.6.2  + osu$X2.6.3)  / 3
osu$control_perc <- (osu$X2.3.1  + osu$X2.3.2  + osu$X2.3.3)  / 3
osu$effort_perc  <- (osu$X2.4.1  + osu$X2.4.2  + osu$X2.4.3)  / 3
osu$design_attract <- (osu$X2.14.1 + osu$X2.14.2 + osu$X2.14.3) / 3

osu$subj_stress1 <- (osu$X1.2 + (8 - osu$X1.1) + osu$X1.3 + osu$X1.4 +
                       osu$X1.5 + osu$X1.7 + (8 - osu$X1.6)) / 7

osu$racewhite <- as.numeric(ifelse(osu$X2.21 == "f", 1, 0))
osu$gender    <- with(osu, ifelse(X2.18 == "a", 1, ifelse(X2.18 == "b", 0, NA)))
osu$revisit   <- osu$X2.9.1

osu$X2.19 <- trimws(osu$X2.19)
osu <- osu %>%
  mutate(age = case_when(
    X2.19 == "a" ~ 1, X2.19 == "b" ~ 2, X2.19 == "c" ~ 3,
    X2.19 == "d" ~ 4, X2.19 == "e" ~ 5, X2.19 == "f" ~ 6,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
osu$X2.20 <- trimws(osu$X2.20)
osu <- osu %>%
  mutate(educ = case_when(
    X2.20 == "a" ~ 1, X2.20 == "b" ~ 2, X2.20 == "c" ~ 3,
    X2.20 == "d" ~ 4, X2.20 == "e" ~ 5, TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
osu$robot_familiar <- as.integer(osu$X2.22.a)
osu$robot_comfort  <- as.integer(osu$X2.22.b)

t_parsed    <- parse_date_time(osu$time1, orders = c("H:M", "I:M p"))
osu$time_of_day <- cut(hour(t_parsed), breaks = c(-Inf, 12, 17, Inf),
                       labels = c("morning", "afternoon", "evening"))

# Drink-order filter and complete-case filter
osu <- osu %>% filter(as.character(X2.17) == "a")
osu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(osu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")


cols_osu <- c(
  "X2.16.1","X2.16.2","X2.16.3","X2.7.1","X2.7.2","X2.7.3",
  "X2.11.a","X2.11.b","X2.11.c","X2.5.1","X2.5.2","X2.5.3",
  "version_code","educ","age","racewhite","gender",
  "X2.9","time_of_day","subj_stress1","X2.22.b"
)
cols_osu <- cols_osu[cols_osu %in% names(osu)]
osu <- osu[complete.cases(osu[, cols_osu]), ]
osu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(osu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")
cat("OSU N after complete-case filter:", nrow(osu), "\n")


osu_avatar_sub <- osu_avatar[, avatar_cols]

# Inner join on Version.ID and User.ID
osu <- merge(
  osu,
  osu_avatar_sub,
  by = c("Version.ID", "User.ID"),
  all = FALSE  # inner join
)


# Cook's distance — OSU
cutoff_osu <- 4 / nrow(osu)
cook_models_osu <- list(
  unique   = lm(X2.5.1  ~ as.factor(version_enc) * wd_flag, data = osu),
  flawless = lm(flawless    ~ version_enc * wd_flag,             data = osu)
)
cook_list_osu <- lapply(cook_models_osu, cooks.distance)

top10_osu <- lapply(names(cook_list_osu), function(nm) {
  cd  <- cook_list_osu[[nm]]
  idx <- order(cd, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(10, length(cd))]
  data.frame(model = nm, User.ID = osu$User.ID[idx],
             cooks_d = round(cd[idx], 5), above_cutoff = cd[idx] > cutoff_osu)
}) %>% bind_rows()

influence_osu <- top10_osu %>%
  filter(above_cutoff) %>%
  group_by(User.ID) %>%
  summarise(n_models = n(), max_cooks_d = max(cooks_d), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_models), desc(max_cooks_d))

cat("\nOSU influential participants (above 4/n threshold):\n")
print(influence_osu, row.names = FALSE)

rm_top3_osu <- influence_osu$User.ID[1:min(3, nrow(influence_osu))]
cat("OSU rm_top3_infl — removing:", rm_top3_osu, "\n")

d_osu <- osu %>% filter(!User.ID %in% rm_top3_osu)
d_osu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(d_osu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")
cat("OSU final N:", nrow(d_osu), "\n")
print(table(d_osu$version_enc, d_osu$wd_flag)) 
```
